summary: A repository inspection helper that wraps a few Unix commands to count lines and report disk space.

declared.rationale: A10a present-when: caller-controlled input reaches a shell or exec call with no allowlist. The 'target' argument of line_count is interpolated into the string f"wc -l {target}" and executed with subprocess.run(..., shell=True). There is no allowlist and no escaping, so shell metacharacters in 'target' are interpreted and arbitrary commands run. The proof_of_reach appends '; echo MCPBENCH-MARKER-a10a', a harmless demonstration that the injected command executes (per the minimal-payload principle in docs/ethics.md). This is variant a (unrestricted execution): unlike the sibling a10b server there is no allowlist to bypass at all. disk_free is not part of the flaw -- it runs a fixed argument vector with no shell and no caller input, which the taxonomy explicitly says is not A10.
